reuse: Pure read-only business-scoped projector; two-business runtime fixture; configurable timezone; no provider execution or new authority
exceptions: Pending/unresolved payments, pending/review refunds, missing dates, invalid amounts, duplicates, mismatches, over-refunds and paid-but-unfulfilled purchases

definitions.channel: Explicit recorded channel only; missing legacy provenance remains Not recorded
definitions.net: Period confirmed sales minus period completed refunds; may be negative
definitions.purchaseCount: Purchases created in period, including unpaid drafts; confirmed-sale count separate
definitions.gross: Confirmed purchase total, including stored transaction tax, by business payment confirmation date
definitions.currency: Separate totals; no exchange rate inference
definitions.refunds: Completed refund operations at first recorded completion observation

localBrowser: Refund-only date range preserves original sale

access.frontDesk: Existing own-sale receipts only; financial report denied
access.server: Existing authoritative visibleStaffData and membership scope remain enforced

checks: Authenticated Owner/Admin financial report matches authoritative totals
Custom October 5 period shows USD 60 sales, USD 120 refunds, USD -60 net
All-dates refresh restores USD 180 sales, USD 120 refunds, USD 60 net

crashRecovery: Session interruption after completed hosted verification; branch and source commit intact; preexisting unrelated work preserved; closure resumed without broad re-verification.
